name: publishProviderConfigs
description: Guest pushes effective provider configs (from settings.json providers.configs) to the C++ LLM broker so it configures providers from settings.json and refreshes the pref cold-boot cache.

inputs.name: payload
inputs.description: { configs: {<providerId>: {apiKey,baseUrl,defaultModel,model,enabledModels,userAgent,declaredHosts,...}}, activeProviderId?: string } dict. userAgent: a preset User-Agent the provider sends on its requests; '' or absent = the host default. declaredHosts: host names beside the base URL's domain that the provider's raw transport may reach, https on the default port, exact host; absent = none.
